title: Deposit Handling Fee on Long-Held Resort Deposits — Room Reservations Fee Schedule
content:
## Fee schedule

When money held on a Room Reservations reservation is refunded after a no-show, the deposit handling fee is taken off the money held less the amount kept, and what remains, never below zero, is refunded. When the hotel is an Ashbury Reserve and the reservation was booked at least 100 days before the refund is made, the deposit handling fee is the Reserve long-hold fee of 45.00; when the hotel is an Ashbury Resort & Spa and the reservation was booked at least 100 days before the refund, it is the resort long-hold fee of 25.00; any other refund carries no handling fee (0.00).

| Hotel brand on the reservation | Booked 100 days or more before the refund | Booked fewer than 100 days before the refund |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Reserve | 45.00 | none |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 25.00 | none |
| Ashbury Express, Ashbury Inn & Suites, Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand | none | none |

**Counting the days.** Calendar days from the booked date on the reservation to the day the refund is made. Exactly 100 days counts as at least 100 days.

**Boundary (hypothetical Ashbury Reserve reservation booked on 1 February 2027).** A refund made on 12 May 2027 is 100 days after booking: fee 45.00. A refund made on 11 May 2027 is 99 days after booking: no fee.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Money held less the amount kept of 280.00 at an Ashbury Resort & Spa, booked 150 days before the refund: 280.00 less 25.00 leaves a refund of 255.00.
